brief:
# Build: full-voice-and-ai-control-of-everything-in-the-console-before-the-android-app

## Brett said (verbatim)
> 

## What to build
Continue build "Full voice and AI control of EVERYTHING in the console, before the Android app: every action, setting, tab, dialog, menu, list, item and field gets an API (REST, MCP, CLI, voice). Add find-by-content deep links down to the item: 'jump to the plan about X, the step that mentions Y' searches inside pl" (full-voice-and-ai-control-of-everything-in-the-console-before-the-android-app) — Phase 1, model Opus.
Model switches: a downgrade (e.g. Fable → Opus) is fine. Fable upgrades need no approval right now (Brett, Nov 4 2026: "If it needs Fable, set it to be Fable"): a step that needs Fable (schemas, asset types, contracts, engines/kernel, cross-app protocols) is set to Fable and runs on Fable; the switch is recorded on the build. Never launch a step on a higher model than it is pinned to: raise the step first.
Rules: stay in this one session; no sub-agents; steps ≤ 30 min; read only the files listed; stop at the end of this phase.
Look: UI code (handwritten or generated) conforms to the hot-swappable asset system: every colour, size, spacing, font, radius and border comes from asset tokens (--fx-* colour/style, --fx-type-* / --fx-dens-* / --fx-size-* scale, --fx-radius-*, --fx-border-w; Kotlin: Axf.colors / Axf.type / Axf.space / Axf.shapes), framework controls instead of raw ones, no var() fallbacks. `node framework/cli/check-theme.mjs` and `check-controls.mjs` must pass (CI fails otherwise); `node framework/cli/scale-adopt.mjs <path>` moves most literals onto the tokens.
API: Everything comes with an API (Brett, Nov 8 2026): anything this build adds or changes that has a UI gets full API control: a deep link that opens it (console_show / console_open target), its state readable, and every action and setting it offers callable without the UI, through the console API (REST), MCP tools (console actions, plugin commands, control@1 for tokens and planner items), the CLI and voice (AmberX), all four the same. A UI-only feature is not done; say in the PR how each one is reached.
Steps in this phase (3 left, ~1.3 h):
[ ] s1 (~30 min) Full voice and AI control of EVERYTHING in the console, before the Android app: every action, setting, tab, dialog, menu, list, item and field gets an API (REST, MCP, CLI, voice).
[ ] s2 (~30 min) Add find-by-content deep links down to the item: 'jump to the plan about X, the step that mentions Y' searches inside pl
[ ] s3 (~20 min) Tests green, report _claude/builds/reports/full-voice-and-ai-control-of-everything-in-the-console-before-the-android-app.md, THREADS row, commit, push, PR
Read first: _claude/builds/reports/full-voice-and-ai-control-of-everything-in-the-console-before-the-android-app.md, _claude/THREADS.md
Tick each step: node apps/console-web/plugins/build-orchestrator/orchestrator.mjs act step full-voice-and-ai-control-of-everything-in-the-console-before-the-android-app <stepId> done — it reaches main at once (builds-live). Link your branch / PR: node framework/cli/builds-live.mjs link full-voice-and-ai-control-of-everything-in-the-console-before-the-android-app --branch <b> --pr <n>.
Watch live: when you start on a screen, run `node framework/cli/axf.mjs focus <app> [route] [css-selector] --note "…"` so the live preview follows you.
Screenshots that are not for approval (checking a screen, live captures, before/after): axf shot <file> --name "…" --app … --screen … --group "<build name>" (UI Review → Screenshots; ui-review-item@1), never the review queue.

## Pipeline
This session was started by the orchestrator's dispatcher on Claude account mossesx-max- for the Opus phase. Tick every step as you finish it (orchestrator.mjs act step full-voice-and-ai-control-of-everything-in-the-console-before-the-android-app <stepId> done). When this phase's steps are done, stop: the dispatcher starts the next phase on the right account. If you must stop early with steps left, say why in a build note (orchestrator.mjs act note full-voice-and-ai-control-of-everything-in-the-console-before-the-android-app "…"); the build goes back to Pending for Brett.
